Researcher Jeremy Rys joins Danny Jones to link Jeffrey Epstein to UFO files and to claim that link explains his death. The episode title says the files make clear why they killed him. Rys works the seam where UFO lore meets crime.

Rys lays out the names, labs, and donors that tie Epstein's world to craft research. He argues Epstein knew too much about the wrong program. Jones asks what of this can be shown on paper. Listeners get a dark knot of two huge tales tied as one. The library holds the talk as an archive record, and readers judge the links themselves.
